name: dhw_tank_dynamic
title: Domestic hot-water storage tank: dynamic temperature evolution
summary: Transient energy balance of a fully mixed 500 L domestic hot-water tank over a 5-hour scenario (10 kW heater for 1 h, cooldown, 2 h tap draw with 12 C make-up water, ambient losses), integrated with INTEGRAL and a 1-s step.

authors: N. Paulus (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory)
B. Dechesne (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory)
origin.course: MECA0002-1 Thermodynamique appliquée et introduction aux machines thermiques (ULiège), repetition 3, exercise 3

verification.reference: Integral table stored in the source EES file (18 001 rows at 1 s, decoded from the embedded plot data): tank trajectory of the native file dhw_tank_dynamic.eescode compared point by point (the native file is the verified file)
verification.notes: Native file vs EES over all 18 001 points (re-decoded from the plot objects for this re-check): T_tank max 3.1e-5, dU/dtau and Q_dot_amb max 6.1e-5, Q_dot_tap max 1.3e-5, schedules exact; final T 39.4409 vs 39.4397 C. M_tank and v_tank agree with the EES stored solution to 10 digits. Native file solved with CoolSolve branch fix/library-gaps-2 (CS-GAP-IF5, CS-GAP-INTEGRAL-LIMITS, CS-BUG-INTEGRAL-TABLE-SEP, CS-BUG-INTEGRAL-MAXSTEPS closed): 18 000 steps in about 1 min 30 s, without coolsolve.conf; the 19 scalars common to the two .sol files and the 18 001-row trajectory are equal to those of the former _coolsolve variant (removed).
